description: This file defines an abstract class 'ConnectionIssue' used for representing information about connection problems encountered during log consistency operations in Orleans.

classes.name: ConnectionIssue
classes.description: Represents connection issues within log consistency protocols, tracking timestamps, failure counts, and retry delay logic.

methods.name: ComputeRetryDelay
methods.description: Calculates the retry delay based on the current state; intended to be overridden in subclasses.
